buildCmd: rm -rf .next && npm run build && mkdir -p .design-sync/.cache/css .design-sync/.cache/media && cp .next/static/chunks/*.css .design-sync/.cache/css/tailwind-build.css && cp .next/static/media/*.woff2 .design-sync/.cache/media/ 2>/dev/null; cp .next/static/media/*.woff .design-sync/.cache/media/ 2>/dev/null; cp .next/static/media/*.ttf .design-sync/.cache/media/ 2>/dev/null; printf '\n:root{--font-sans:"Poppins","Poppins Fallback"}\n' >> .design-sync/.cache/css/tailwind-build.css; true

dtsPropsFor.AnimatedHeadline: text: string; highlight?: string; as?: "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "p"; className?: string; /** "load" plays on mount (hero); "scroll" waits for viewport entry */ mode?: "load" | "scroll"; delay?: number;
dtsPropsFor.CountUp: value: number; prefix?: string; suffix?: string; duration?: number; className?: string;
dtsPropsFor.GradientMesh: /** "light" for white hero, "dark" for navy closing moment */ variant?: "light" | "dark"; className?: string;
dtsPropsFor.PageHero: eyebrow: string; headline: string; highlight?: string; subline?: string;
dtsPropsFor.Reveal: children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; as?: "div" | "section" | "ul" | "header"; /** Stagger direct children instead of fading the wrapper as one */ stagger?: boolean; delay?: number;
dtsPropsFor.SectionHeading: eyebrow?: string; title: string; body?: string; /** "light" for white/paper sections, "dark" for ink/navy moments */ tone?: "light" | "dark"; align?: "left" | "center"; className?: string;

libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: synth-entry barrel used export * only, which never re-exports a module's default binding (ESM semantics) — all 9 components/ui files are export-default, so none landed on window.AurifyUI. Fork adds an export{default as Name} alias per file.
